name: 1N34A
description: Germanium point-contact diode with a low ~0.3V forward drop. The classic AM crystal-radio detector, and prized in guitar fuzz/clipping for its soft, asymmetric character versus silicon. Higher leakage and lower current handling than silicon. Banded end is the cathode.

DO-7.notes: small glass axial body; the band marks the cathode.

typical_application: Crystal-radio AM envelope detector, soft clipping in fuzz pedals (often a matched pair), low-level signal rectification where the low forward drop matters.
gotchas: high reverse leakage and wide part-to-part spread; for fuzz circuits people hand-select by forward voltage
low current and power handling; not a rectifier
germanium is temperature-sensitive; bias and tone drift with heat
genuine NOS parts are often relabeled or out of spec; measure before trusting
